caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular, tightly arranged geometric pattern composed of repeated grid-like motifs resembling a woven textile. The design includes alternating blocks and bands of red, blue, and beige colors. The red and blue sections are made up of small, regularly spaced marks and shapes, such as rectangles and dots, organized in horizontal and vertical alignments, with beige used as a background color that separates and surrounds these blocks. The overall pattern is symmetrically balanced, with a central concentration of vertical and horizontal elements forming a square motif in the middle, which is bordered on all sides by additional bands of complex patterns. The background of the drawing is plain beige with scattered small brown spots, and the lower right corner contains a hand-written signature “Christoffels.”
title: Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
